item.title: Column: A FRESH PERSPECTIVE – International Holocaust Remembrance Day
item.description: By: Mike Kelly Bryan, Ohio International Holocaust Remembrance Day is on January 27 and marks the anniversary of the liberation of Auschwitz-Birkenau Extermination Camp by Soviet troops in 1945. The United Nations designated this date in 2005 as International Holocaust Remembrance Day to officially honor the victims of Nazism and promote Holocaust education worldwide.
